vigil_assessment.factual_basis: The selected evidence reports: Mimikama documents a deliberately fabricated rabies-death story that was ingested into AI search answers and combined with an unrelated legitimate source, demonstrating adversarial content poisoning converted into authoritative-looking synthetic fact.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The reported test deliberately poisoned the retrievable information environment and AI search systems converted that compromised material into authoritative-seeming fact. The occurrence therefore combines epistemic reliance miscalibration with failure to recognise and discount adversarial evidence poisoning.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: For CAM, the occurrence demonstrates a cross-domain SECURITY–ECONOMICS–epistemic integrity pathway: adversarial content targeted trust and reputational value, while the retrieval systems failed to preserve a sufficiently sceptical evidence posture before converting the poisoned material into public factual synthesis. Reputational or status value is an affected value axis; adversarial evidence-poisoning acceptance is the reusable system failure.
